Name: No Redecorating Please
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
There's a random chance that when you wake up in the morning you'll find that your spouse or roommate has ordered a new chair or something, or turned your nice wood slat floor into a pile of leaves. They mean well but please leave the decorating to the farmer thanks. This mod prevents them from changing the decor of your house.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=4][url=https://github.com/Spiderbuttons/StardewBTN/tree/main/NoRedecoratingPlease]Source Code[/url][/size]
